{{Short description|none}}
The '''2024 Copa Libertadores final stages''' were played from 13 August to 30 November 2024.<ref>{{cite web|url=https://www.conmebol.com/noticias/las-fechas-para-tener-en-cuenta-en-los-torneos-de-clubes/|title=Calendario de la CONMEBOL Libertadores y CONMEBOL Sudamericana 2024|trans-title=2024 CONMEBOL Libertadores and CONMEBOL Sudamericana schedule|publisher=CONMEBOL|language=es|date=30 November 2023|access-date=15 May 2024}}</ref> A total of 16 teams competed in the final stages to decide the champions of the [[2024 Copa Libertadores]],<ref name="regulations">{{cite web|url=https://cdn.conmebol.com/wp-content/uploads/2023/12/Manual-de-Clubes-CL-2024-ESP-Digital.pdf|title=Manual de Clubes CONMEBOL Libertadores 2024|publisher=CONMEBOL|language=es|date=13 December 2023|access-date=15 May 2024}}</ref> with the final played at [[Estadio Monumental (Buenos Aires)|Estadio Monumental]] in [[Buenos Aires]], Argentina.<ref>{{cite web|url=https://www.futbolred.com/copa-libertadores/la-afa-anuncio-que-buenos-aires-se-jugara-la-final-de-la-copa-libertadores-2024-200760 |title=Definida la sede de la final de Libertadores 2024: ¿Dónde se jugará? |trans-title=The venue for the 2024 Libertadores final is set: Where will it be played? |publisher=Futbolred |language=es |date=13 February 2024 |access-date=15 May 2024}}</ref><ref>{{cite web|url=https://www.conmebol.com/noticias/la-final-de-la-conmebol-libertadores-2024-se-disputara-en-el-estadio-monumental/ |title=La Final de la CONMEBOL Libertadores 2024 se disputará en el Estadio Monumental |trans-title=The 2024 CONMEBOL Libertadores Final will be played at Estadio Monumental |publisher=CONMEBOL |language=es |date=4 October 2024 |access-date=4 October 2024}}</ref>

==Format==
<section begin=Format />
Starting from the round of 16, the teams played a [[single-elimination tournament]] with the following rules:<ref name="regulations"/>
*In the round of 16, quarter-finals and semi-finals, each tie was played on a home-and-away [[two-legged tie|two-legged]] basis, with the higher-seeded team hosting the second leg (Regulations Article 2.2.3.2). If tied on aggregate, [[Overtime (sports)#Association football|extra time]] would not be played, and a [[penalty shoot-out (association football)|penalty shoot-out]] would be used to determine the winners (Regulations Article 2.4.3).
*The final was played as a single match at a venue pre-selected by CONMEBOL, with the higher-seeded team designated as the "home" team for administrative purposes (Regulations Article 2.2.3.5). If tied after regulation, 30 minutes of [[Overtime (sports)#Association football|extra time]] would be played. If still tied after extra time, a [[penalty shoot-out (association football)|penalty shoot-out]] would be used to determine the winners (Regulations Article 2.4.4).<section end=Format />

==Draw==
<section begin=Draw />
The draw for the round of 16 was held on 3 June 2024, 12:00 [[Time in Paraguay|PYT]] ([[UTC−04:00|UTC−4]]) in [[Asunción]], Paraguay.<ref>{{cite web|url=https://www.beinsports.com/es-us/football/copa-conmebol-libertadores/articles-video/fecha-confirmada-para-el-sorteo-de-los-octavos-de-final-de-la-conmebol-libertadores-2024-04-29|title=Fecha confirmada para el sorteo de los Octavos de Final de la CONMEBOL Libertadores|trans-title=Date confirmed for the CONMEBOL Libertadores's Round of 16 draw|publisher=[[beIN Sports (American TV channel)|beIN Sports]]|language=es|date=29 April 2024|access-date=15 May 2024}}</ref><ref>{{cite web|url=https://www.conmebol.com/noticias/pautas-de-sorteo-para-octavos-de-final/|title=Pautas de sorteo para Octavos de Final|trans-title=Draw guidelines for the Round of 16|publisher=CONMEBOL|language=es|date=31 May 2024|access-date=1 June 2024}}</ref> For the round of 16, the 16 teams were drawn into eight ties (A–H) between a group winner (Pot 1) and a group runner-up (Pot 2), with the group winners hosting the second leg. Teams from the same association or the same group could be drawn into the same tie (Regulations Article 2.2.3.2).<ref name="regulations"/><section end=Draw />

==Quarter-finals==
===Summary===
The first legs were played on 17–19 September, and the second legs were played on 24–26 September 2024.<ref name="QF fixture">{{cite web|url=https://www.conmebol.com/noticias/fixture-de-cuartos-de-final-para-la-conmebol-libertadores-2024/|title=Fixture de Cuartos de Final para la CONMEBOL Libertadores 2024|trans-title=Quarter-finals Fixture for the 2024 CONMEBOL Libertadores|language=es|publisher=CONMEBOL|date=26 August 2024|access-date=26 August 2024}}</ref><ref name="QF fixture pdf">{{cite web|url=https://cdn.conmebol.com/wp-content/uploads/2024/08/Fixture-Libertadores_Cuartos-de-Final_2024.pdf|title=CONMEBOL LIBERTADORES 2024 {{!}} PROGRAMA DE PARTIDOS - CUARTOS DE FINAL {{!}} Departamento de Competiciones {{!}} 26/8/2024|language=es|publisher=CONMEBOL|date=26 August 2024|access-date=26 August 2024}}</ref>
<section begin=Quarter-finals />{{#invoke:Sports series|main
|[[Fluminense FC|Fluminense]]|BRA|1–2|[[Clube Atlético Mineiro|Atlético Mineiro]]|BRA|[[2024 Copa Libertadores final stages#Match S1.1|1–0]]|[[2024 Copa Libertadores final stages#Match S1.2|0–2]]
|[[Botafogo de Futebol e Regatas|Botafogo]]|BRA|1–1 {{pso|5–4}}|[[São Paulo FC|São Paulo]]|BRA|[[2024 Copa Libertadores final stages#Match S2.1|0–0]]|[[2024 Copa Libertadores final stages#Match S2.2|1–1]]

}}<section end=Quarter-finals />

==Semi-finals==
===Summary===
The first legs were played on 22 and 23 October, and the second legs were played on 29 and 30 October 2024.<ref name="SF fixture">{{cite web|url=https://www.conmebol.com/noticias/calendario-de-partidos-semifinales/|title=Calendario de partidos – Semifinales|trans-title=Match schedule – Semifinals|language=es|publisher=CONMEBOL|date=27 September 2024|access-date=27 September 2024}}</ref><ref name="SF fixture pdf">{{cite web|url=https://cdn.conmebol.com/wp-content/uploads/2024/09/Fixture-CONMEBOL-Libertadores_Semifinales_2024.pdf|title=CONMEBOL LIBERTADORES 2024 {{!}} PROGRAMA DE PARTIDOS - SEMIFINALES {{!}} Departamento de Competiciones {{!}} 27/9/2024|language=es|publisher=CONMEBOL|date=27 September 2024|access-date=27 September 2024}}</ref>
